## What’s new
- 2,818 additional distinct first names and surnames, with name pools for all 211 selectable nationalities.
- New worlds avoid repeated full names. Youth scouting checks prospects against existing players and earlier reports. Existing players keep their names.

## Fixes and improvements
- Formation menus scroll within the list and fit the available screen, including smaller displays and the on-screen keyboard.
- Goal targets are fairer in small leagues.
- Manager salary payments retain unpaid days when advancing time and settle remaining pay at contract expiry.
- Takeovers finish only when due, cannot fund the club twice, and remain intact during ownership reviews.
- A compact What’s New summary is available in all 12 supported languages.

**Android ARM64 • v0.6.1 • Build 337**

Thank you for playing and sharing your feedback.
